Following WhatsApp's earlier rollout of a limited emoji reaction feature on Apple Watch, the messaging app is now further expanding support for the full emoji library on watchOS. Details below.

WhatsApp Expands watchOS Emoji Reaction Feature

At the end of last year, WhatsApp launched a full-featured Apple Watch app supporting incoming call notifications, voice messages, chat history, and emoji reactions.

This update is undoubtedly welcome news for Apple Watch users, particularly because WhatsApp's previous watchOS support had been quite limited, relying almost entirely on system notifications for reading and replying to messages.

However, the emoji reaction feature still came with one notable limitation at the time: users could only pick from six preset emojis. To react with any other emoji, they had to pick up their iPhone.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is now gradually rolling out support for the full emoji library on watchOS. The site notes that long-pressing a message will still display the six preset reactions, but users can now open a larger picker containing recently used options as well as the complete system emoji library organised by category.

WABetaInfo reports:

The site also mentioned that although this feature is now officially rolling out, given WhatsApp's well-known staged rollout approach, it may still take several weeks before reaching all users.
